index.copy:
Womasulira Zilembo za AI Waulere

Uwu ndi chida chomasulira zilembo cha pa intaneti chaulere chomwe chimayendetsedwa ndi mitundu ikuluikulu ya chinenero. Tumizani mafayilo a SRT, VTT kapena ASS ndikumasulira zilembo pakati pa Chingerezi, Chitchaina, Chijapani, Chikorea, Chisipanishi, Chifalansa ndi zinenero zina 15+. Palibe kulembetsa, palibe kuyika, palibe chizindikiro — tsegulani mu msakatuli ndikuyamba kumasulira. Deti la zilembo limakhalabe mu msakatuli wanu pokhapokha mutayambitsa kumasulira kwa mtambo.

Zinthu zazikulu: Kutanthauzira kwa SRT, VTT ndi ASS ndi kumasulira kwa AI, kuphatikiza mwanzeru ziganizo (pamene chiganizo chimodzi chimafalikira muzithunzi zingapo, zithunzi zimaphatikizidwa, kutanthauziridwa, kenako n'kugawidwanso pa nthawi yake), kulumikiza nthawi, kukulunga mizere yokha kwa malemba a CJK ndi Western, kuchotsa mau osafunikira, kusamalira mawu achizolowezi, ndi masitaelo osankhidwa omasulira. Tumizani kunja mafayilo wamba a SRT, VTT, ASS kapena TXTokonzekera kuika pansi pa kanema wanu.

Amene amagwiritsa ntchito: omasulira mavidiyo, olenga za YouTube ndi omasulira kudziko lakwawo, ophunzira a zilankhulo, magulu a zilembo ndi timu zomwe zimafunikira kumasulira mavidiyo mwamsanga.

Nthawi zomwe zimabwera zopanda pake zimayikidwa ku ziro, ndipo chidachi chimakuuzani zingati zomwe zakhudzidwa. Mtundu womwewo ukulowetsawa, mtundu womwewo ukutulukamo - palibe kusintha, ndipo masitaelo a ASS, masitaelo a mzere ndi zizindikiro zimayendetsedwa monga momwe zinaliri. ytfix.intro: Ikani fayilo ya mawu a YouTube, sankhani chilankhulo, ndipo chidachi chidzalumikiza ziganizo pamodzi m'magawo, kenako chidzadulanso fayiloyo chiganizo ndi chiganizo. Palibe mawu amodzi omwe amasintha, ndipo nthawi za magawo zimakhala pafupi ndi nthawi zoyambirira momwe zingathere.
ytfix.feat: Mawu a YouTube amadulidwa m'magawo a masekondi 3-4 mosasamala kanthu za komwe ziganizo zimathera, motero gawo limodzi nthawi zambiri limakhala ndi mapeto a chiganizo cham'mbuyo ndi chiyambi cha chotsatira. Chidachi chimagwiritsa ntchito nthawi zoyambirira ngati maziko - nthawi zimenezo ndizo malire enieni a mawu omwe makina adazindikira - chimaganiza komwe chiganizo chilichonse chimathera kuchokera ku zizindikiro, ndikugwiritsa ntchito njira zamphamvu kusankha malo abwino odulira pakati pa mapeto a chiganizo, koma, mgwirizano ndi kudula kolimba, kenako chimatalikitsa nthawi yowonetsera kuti igwirizane ndi liwiro la kuwerenga. Chilankhulo chilichonse cha 100 chili ndi malamulo ake a ziganizo: Chitchainizi ndi Chijapani zilibe mipata pakati pa mawu, Chithai chimangolemba malire a mawu pang'ono, Chihindi chimatha ziganizo ndi ।, Chiarabu ndi ؟, Chiarmeniya ndi ։. M'lifupi mwa mzere ndi liwiro la kuwerenga zimatsata dongosolo lolemba - zilembo 16 zathunthu pa mzere uliwonse wa Chitchainizi, zilembo 42 za zilembo za Chilatini. Musanatumize, mawu amafanizidwa chilembo ndi chilembo, ndipo mawu aliwonse otayika kapena owonjezeredwa amawonetsedwa nthawi yomweyo.
ytfix.who: Magulu a omasulira omwe akusandutsa mawu a YouTube, ma podcast ndi maphunziro kukhala mawu omalizidwa, ndi opanga mavidiyo omwe atopa ndi ziganizo zomwe zimayima pakati.
